## Concept: hard and soft targets
What the student is trained toward at one token: the token the teacher wrote (hard), or the teacher's
probabilities over every token (soft).

{{< include _token.qmd >}}
:::

::: {.card}
#### B: SFT on teacher outputs

| Trains toward | Labels | GPU-hours | Test-clean | BFCL | Decision |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| the teacher's written token | no | 3.1 | 83.4% | 79.1% | ADR 0006 |

{{< include _m-hard.qmd >}}
:::

::: {.card}
#### C: logit distillation

| Trains toward | Labels | GPU-hours | Test-clean | BFCL | Decision |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| the teacher's top 20 + the rest | no | 4.7 | 82.5% | 81.6% | ADR 0010 |

{{< include _m-soft.qmd >}}
:::

::: {.card}
#### D: on-policy distillation

| Trains toward | Labels | GPU-hours | Test-clean | BFCL | Decision |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| the teacher's scores on the student's own answer | no | 13.5 | 83.3% | 82.5% | ADR 0008 |

{{< include _m-onpolicy.qmd >}}
